counterfactual_missing_items: septations or loculations to support mucinous cystadenoma
absence of uterine/ovarian involvement to support mesenteric cyst
positive Echinococcus serology or calcifications to support echinococcal cyst
decisive_items: demonstrated no calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations
response.rationale: R2 is supported by specific imaging features (no septations, no solid components) and large size, consistent with a benign serous cystadenoma. R5 is less specific, relying on family history and generic benign description. R3 is contradicted by the cyst involving uterus and ovaries, R4 by the absence of septations, and R1 by negative serology. Append-only completions (C1-C4) add no new raw evidence.

rejected.why: Negative Echinococcus serology directly contradicts the diagnosis.
The cyst involving the uterus and ovaries argues against a mesenteric origin.
Absence of septations and solid components makes mucinous cystadenoma unlikely.
Append-only completion of R2 with no additional raw support; redundant.
Append-only completion of R3 with no additional raw support; redundant and parent already rejected.
Append-only completion of R4 with no additional raw support; redundant and parent already rejected.
Append-only completion of R5 with no additional raw support; redundant.
